reviews.title: Hidden fees
reviews.text:
Title: Hidden fees and a discouraging experience
Review:
I’m giving QuickBooks 1 star because the fees feel hidden and the pricing isn’t clear upfront. I signed up expecting straightforward costs, but instead kept running into extra charges that weren’t obvious until after I was already using the product.
The mobile app only adds to the frustration. Basic things that should be easy—like finding merchant services/payment settings—take too much digging, and the layout feels confusing and inconsistent. Overall, it’s been a discouraging experience and I wouldn’t recommend it if you want transparent pricing and a simple app.

reviews.title: QuickBooks dropped the ball

They now have reverted to QuickBooks Solepreneur which is actually labeled QuickBooks Business in the App Store. This new interface does not include quick buttons at the bottom of the screen for easy referencing to mileage, expenses, etc., you must go through the main menu now which is super annoying. Also, now none of my mileage will track while the app is closed like before even after changing the settings. Also none of my expenses are accessible through the app prior to June 1 of this year, another huge problem. Another annoying thing is it requires Face ID every time I login, even after changing the settings to not require it. This change was a huge shaft to my small business this year. I used and trusted Intuit QuickBooks Self Employed for so long, however I cannot deal with how stupid this app is now. I will be going to Everlance come the 1st of the year. My question still remains is, who thought this change was going to be a good idea? You have unlimited funds as far as a company goes, just make a separate app for other stuff and leave the one that works alone. :(

reviews.title: Theft
reviews.text:
On Friday, 9/19/26, at about 1:30pm, I attempted to reactivate our QB acct, which we cancelled in 5/26 bc my husband was hospitalized numerous times with a severe autoimmune disorder and we were not sure he’d ever be able to return to work. He has since gone into remission and we want to reactivate our subscription and resume running our company. Upon authorizing a payment of $29.99 for QB Simple Start through the Apple Store, I was still not able to access our account - but we decided to wait until Monday to allow the payment time to process. 

Long story short, I have, since Monday 9/21/26, spoken to 6 different agents and managers in General Support and Technical Support who all claim that QB did not receive my resubscription payment, yet that payment has cleared both Apple and my credit card. Despite several 3-way calls with both, and despite providing documentation via email, my QB subscription remains “cancelled.” I will be seeking legal representation to pursue charges of corporate theft of my money.

(For a company using so much AI I assumed it would be able to tell 20L of diesel from 500ml of Fanta). 

Then the app updates for “new and improved features” basically a way to spend abit of money to justify a price a hike next year. It’s now a buggy and bloated app. The “take a quick snap of receipts” is now constantly loading and re loading the app. Waiting for it to load. 

If you are thinking of getting this as a sole trader for a simple “making tax digital” app. Just avoid. I’ve got a year subscription then I’ll change software this may have been designed to as something more like a do it all app. But as the saying goes if you try to please everyone you please no one. Clearly designed by someone who is PAYE 🤣

reviews.title: Every update gets worse
reviews.text:
The mobile app has been practically unusable since I’ve had it, no matter how many times I update, delete and redownload, etc. I can’t switch between apps without it logging me out completely, half the loading screens make the app freeze and crash.

More importantly, the AI stuff is overreaching massively. The company I work for has always had auto-reminders for unpaid invoices turned off, and a recent update started sending out reminders, harassing our customers completely against our will without even mentioning anything. It also shows customers draft invoices that haven’t even been sent yet when they’re paying earlier invoices, so now they’re confused and trying to pay invoices that aren’t even finished and weren’t sent. We keep having to apologize on QB’s behalf. It’s actively damaging relationships with customers. The only reason this company does so well is because there isn’t big enough competition so people feel like they have no choice but to settle with this one.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: Doesn’t want to open invoices from the app and always crashing.

reviews.title: DONT USE THIS APP
reviews.text:
Please for the love of god, don’t download this app. Previous version was very easy to use. This is insanely difficult to understand. Spent almost an hour on the phone to one of the agents just to get my bank reconnected from previous application. Sent invoices not showing, invoices paid but no way of confirming that on the app. It wants to review and send them again.
I could honestly go on and on, but you get the picture

reviews.title: Avoid this app, it is not fit for purpose
reviews.text:
Quickbooks pushed me to moved over to this app from the self employed version previously used and now discontinued. The app is absolutely appalling and not at all fit for purpose.

It crashes all the time, the loading time for most links is ridiculous, many pages you can navigate to, don’t have close or return tabs so once you reach them, the only way out is to close the app completely and start again. 

Simple functions that are most commonly used and used to take 3 actions, now take over 10 and are buried in sub menus and hard to find such as marking invoices as paid.

Whoever designed and tested this app wants to have a good word with themselves, it’s horrendous and completely unfit for commercial use and subscription

reviews.title: App is useless
reviews.text: App is honestly the worst app I’ve used. It almost never loads and when it does it takes forever. Forget quickly snapping a receipt. They update it so frequently that you don’t know where anything is and it gets worse with every update. Use xero or something else.

reviews.title: Anything But Quick….
reviews.text: Sadly version 26.07.9 is anything but quick, hanging when you trying and log in, plus it doesn’t appear you can send statements from the app.

reviews.title: Please undo latest update!
reviews.text:
Update 2/8/26
Still absolutely garbage, always crashing, credit card statement from Lloyds bank won’t load transactions. Very slow and clunky. If I wasn’t so integrated in to it, I’d absolutely ditch it. 

Invoice order is unusable - Worked perfectly before. Can’t attach a PDF to a gmail email - just keeps adding a link, even though all settings are correct. Please change the invoice menu back to the previous version!!

MARCH 2026 update: very poor. I can’t add a date to the service in the app. All tabs are correct in settings and there’s a date column on the invoice but nowhere to input the date when adding the specific service to the invoice. Please stop messing with the app!!

reviews.title: Kwangjao
reviews.text: Have trouble downloading transactions and still not working for days # the app is too slow to sign in I think I will cancel and unsubscribe

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Just been forced to download and use this app as I had an older version Quick Books Self Employed and half of my invoices etc have disappeared and “contact us” has been pointless thus far - be cancelling soon if its not rectified - avoid

reviews.title: Self Employed was Better
reviews.text: The QuickBooks Self Employed was simple, easy to use, and so quick to check transactions, mileage, invoices, copy invoices (and automatically change the invoice name). This one seems disorganised, messy, and chaotic. Not to mention the use of AI, without opting into AI, and being forced to use this app, full of AI garbage that doesn’t make sense, vs the old app

reviews.title: Recent performance
reviews.text: Recently, every time I go on the app something has changed or pointlessly moved. Today it won’t load at all, nothing works on it whatsoever. It’s so frustrating when you’re paying for it and constantly having to delete and reinstall and mess about trying to load it up.

reviews.title: Slow app
reviews.text: The app is so slow it is frustrating. Please invest in some new software or something. I am trying to run and business, send quotes, write invoices and the app doesn’t want to open.

reviews.title: Why change the app?
reviews.text:
I was almost happily using Self-Employed for years. It generally tracked my millage but sometimes stopped and required me to open the app to start it again. Granted you couldn’t actually review trips the millage in the app as it ran so poorly so had to do that in bulk on my computer. Now they’ve improved things by ending support for the old app and the new one occasionally records my millage, so now I’m going to have to manually do it as I can’t trust it. Or should I invoice this company for lost revenue ?? I’d imagine it’s already missed maybe a couple of grand over the last month or 2 of use. So should I stick with this or start again with xero or something else? I’ll chat with my book keeper and ask what other apps she uses.

Response: no, why don’t you as a company responsible for an accountancy package do some testing? Clearly accuracy isn’t important to you and how can I give you details of missed journeys when by the very definition of “missing” they are absent and I do not have details of them? Also why should I as a paying customer lose money in lost millage also spend time to beta test your software? That kind of attitude stinks of penny pinching and complacency for a company no doubt now owned by some horrific American investment fund who will gut the carcass of this software until it’s worthless

reviews.title: Not Mobile Friendly!
reviews.text:
The app constantly loses connection with the server and ‘snapping’ receipts ‘on the go’ is about as efficient as taking a photograph that needs to be developed in a dark room. 
Constantly have re-upload receipts and the app has recently started blocking the log in page saying the mobile app isn’t supported on my plan (it is !). 
Completely frustrating!

reviews.title: New app
reviews.text: Terrible keeps freezing, can’t review business mileage, can’t mark invoice as paid bank details now not appearing on invoice used for 2 years now this new apps hard work going to start using the banks version

reviews.title: Poor back up
reviews.text:
Very expensive for what it is. Not easy to use. When i had an issue with invoices duplicating the help me and my book keeper received was very poor. 

Hard to talk with a real person. When I could talk the y didn’t seem to understand the problems I was having. 

Looking into moving away from using them.

Fed up with yet more issues.

reviews.title: Terrible since the updates
reviews.text: Crashes, fails to save or load, log in errors, honestly absolutely terrible. Was fine before they changed it. Avoid avoid avoid

reviews.title: Awful App
reviews.text: Husband had to change to this app as the other one finally shut down. It’s bloody awful. The desktop site isn’t much better. It’s not intuitive at all. I suppose we will eventually get used to it but so annoying when the other app was so simple for him to use…. Now it seems clunky and awkward. I’m spending more time on the laptop ensuring things are categorised correctly etc rather than my once a month quick check. If I’d have known before the switch it was this bad I’d have used a different software. And what the hell happened to attaching receipts…. It’s gone from quick click and add, to a 5 step process. Simple Accounting my arse! Only saving grace is it’s actually tracking his mileage …. So far.

reviews.title: Wont open
reviews.text: Now saying I can’t even use the app on my mobile when I open it useless app also owed loads of money for extra companies on my account that I never used and have made it almost impossible to claim my money back for them!

reviews.title: Buggy, slow, can’t do what I need too
reviews.text: I pay £19 a month for this thing. Always been buggy, for a long time it wouldn’t connect my bank account so I was doing it manually, having to use my laptop for VAT…. It’s just bad all round. Tried again to connect my bank through the mobile app…. Nope! There’s free apps out there that can do the same things better…. Why do I pay for this rubbish!?

reviews.title: Lost means to invoice on app
reviews.text:
Since QB has brought out the new packages for sole trades they have taken away the ability to create and send invoice with the app. Can only do them via web which loses convenience. 

Quickbooks you need to reinstate this option

reviews.title: DO NOT SIGN UP TO QUICKBOOKS
reviews.text: It’s not worth the torment of the buggy software. It changes each month that I go to use it for bookkeeping. A new bug each and every month. The latest is that I am no longer able to sign in on my phone as it’s not available? So I transfer to my iPad. I’m now no longer able to edit a transaction and assign it a different VAT treatment whereas I was able to last month. Ruins my workflow and I hate my life every time I have to interact with this software. Cheers Intuit 🍻

reviews.title: The worst app on my phone
reviews.text: The phone app for QuickBooks is utterly awful. It’s constantly buggy. Never wants to open. Repeatedly asks you to sign in, you need to do this several times before it wants to start working. For the monthly cost this is simply unacceptable. I am looking towards using alternative app based accounting software due to this.

reviews.title: Shame about update
reviews.text: Since the new update it’s been bloody awful! Why fix something that wasn’t broken?? Trying to swipe to categorize an expense just goes back to the menu! So bizarre. My 4 year old son could create a better app for expenses.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text:
Doesn’t load every time and now for past three days no transactions from bank showing. The balance updates but can’t link
Invoices or post reciepts. Tried all ways to fix. Both my colleague and myself have access same on both

reviews.title: So bad.
reviews.text: Considering this is meant to be an upgraded from the self employed app it is terrible. The app constantly freezes and logs me out. Tracking mileage hardly ever works. Wish I didn’t have to use it. If an alternative that has the options to track mileage was available I would change.

reviews.title: Complicated/buggy as
reviews.text:
Absolutely despise this app, mileage tracker hardly works, difficult to match receipts to bank transactions, draft invoices disappear from invoice section. 
Cannot simply rename a product when sending invoices to the same supplier when creating invoices in the app, requires entire new product setup. 
Advertising at the bottom of the web version for loans and finance, why do we pay for a membership if you are going to post ads within your software?

Have given it the benefit of the doubt for a years on QB self employed as didn’t wanted to have the hassle of changing to a new product. Think this has finally broken the camels back.

reviews.title: The opposite of quick
reviews.text: The app takes about 2 minutes to open. I’ve usually got bored and given up.

reviews.title: Sole trader
reviews.text: App suddenly stopped working again and says my plan is not supported by the app but it was just the other day. The whole system seems very glitchy, it sometimes tracks my mileage and then doesn’t , it’s supposed to be helping me with my finances but I don’t really trust it

reviews.title: Buggy and not intuitive to use
reviews.text: Keep finding bugs, milage tracking works sometimes but not others, the snap expense thing fails to upload most of the time and when i try and turn a bill into an expense it errors. iPad app hides the done/save buttons at the bottom behind the KB and sometimes will not let you click. The only reason I’m staying is i only paid £12 for the year which is reasonable and will try and stick it out, but not impressed at all. It needs a much more intuitive design. Now I’ve turned CIS on I cannot use the app, can’t do my invoices or even see them. I like to do my invoice before I leave site, but now with cis enabled I can’t and have to wait to get home when I probably forget things. Absolute load of rubbish! Do better! And now everytime I try and go into the app it says I’m not licensed to use it, even though I am!

reviews.title: Very complicated
reviews.text: From a very slick app (Quickbooks self employed) this new app is very difficult to navigate and over complicates everything. For someone like myself who already struggles with this type of app, categorising expenses and trying to figure out what category each transaction should be itemised too is now very difficult. I’m currently looking at different alternatives. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Charging people for a government change is just profiteering
reviews.text: Will be leaving this god awful company since MTD came in as they could not care less about the customer. All they care about is money. No information on MtD unlike SAGE. Will be moving to SAGE and getting rid of this awful company. Their app is awful and constantly changing, they have to be the Trump of companies.

reviews.title: Forced onto this app by quickbooks!
reviews.text: And not impressed in July (our busiest season) having to relearn everything and to find its not as easy as the one we originally signed too!

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: Awful. Quite simply unusable. Have redownloaded several times. Constantly crashing (fully up to date OS on iPhone). Makes it IMPOSSIBLE to run my business. 100% fail. Find an alternative. And a wig to replace the hair you will invariably tear out if you find yourself unlucky enough to be using this PoS app

reviews.title: Completely rubbish
reviews.text: After the change, the application is unuseable at all. I don't have access to my account, despite the fact that I did what they required of me to move. I don't know how to regain access to my account and close it, because it's a waste of time and money.

reviews.title: Awful user experience.
reviews.text: I’ll put it this way. This app is by far the worst I’ve ever used, of any type. I would recommend seeking alternatives. I am.

reviews.title: App stopped working
reviews.text: This app no longer opens. I try multiple times. Sometimes like a miracle it opens. Sort it out

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Never used an app that is so frustrating. Full of glitches. Takes an age to load, sometime doesn’t load at all. Have to go from one screen to another to another just to log in, then usually fails to load. Once in it doesn’t get any better. When typing invoices or estimates if you leave the page to go to find a date on your phone or something in your notes and come back to QuickBooks it’s all gone and back to the Home Screen and hasn’t saved. Also often when your typing out an estimate or invoice and save add the individual item it freezes and you have to restart the app. And again all your work gone. Always been full of bugs and glitches all areas of QuickBooks.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
Been using this app for years but today prompted me to write a review. It does everything you would need to keep your accounts but… it’s so slow!!! It takes forever to log in, I’m currently sat next to my high speed modem and I’ve had to force shut down and log back in, took 2-3 mins just to log in. Out in the wild with anything less than perfect signal and you just cannot log in which is ridiculous in this day and age. The frustration when you are standing in front of a client apologising because you are having to take up their time while waiting for it to load is embarrassing and ridiculous.

I really wish I could switch systems but I’m too far in at this point.

reviews.title: Still broken
reviews.text:
Several recent updates have still left the iOS app with a regular frozen interface which needs to be force-closed and restarted .. sometimes three or four times before I’m able to use the app for anything.

More updates and more non-responsive moments when to try to open the app.  Hangs on an animation screen which says “Loading Your Data” …. which is fair enough if that’s what it was doing, but I’ve left it “loading” for 10, 15 .. 20 mins and it’s obviously just stuck and needs to be force -closed and restarted.  

I give up

reviews.title: Allowed fraudulent charges
reviews.text: Very long story short. We noticed an erroneous instant deposit request which we never do. Reported it immediately, within 1 hour of the request being made. Was promised it would be stopped and removed and nothing else I needed to do. Lies. They not only allowed that request to be processed, they allowed 4 more to the tune of $22,000 by processed through my merchant account somehow without any invoice or payment processed on my side. They not only lied repeatedly saying I didn't need to get my bank involved (I did after they allowed more transactions after all my info was changed). No one ever returned our phone calls that we were promised and we stopped calling trying to fix the problem after the last rep told me"well you signed the terms of agreement" meaning I had to accept the charges bc I signed the agreement. My bank got my money back, then QB sent me to collections lol I disputed the charges and sent all three bureau's screen shots of no response from QB to resolve my problem. They removed the collections and ruled in my favor. DO NOT USE QuickBooks!!!!!!!!!!!!! They know this happens all the time and do nothing to support their customers. We moved to Jobber, protected payment processing and live chat support that actually responds!

reviews.title: A big step backwards from QBSE
reviews.text:
I have been using BQSE for years and found the app stable, functional and intuitive.  Was advised by my bookkeeper to go to QBO simple start.  This has been a nightmare.  The app is over complicated, certainly not intuitive and isnt functioning anywhere near as well.  The big sell for QB seems to be uploading receipts.  The app will only find a transaction match for about 1 in 10.  The browser version works fine.  You cannot see if you have uploaded a receipt to a transaction unless you click on each individual one.  The terminology isnt consistent and therefore confusing. 

Once a transaction has been posted you cant edit it in the app, you could on QBSE.  And also just call them Reviewed / Unreviewed! Then allow a sort function when viewing them like QBSE i.e category, receipt attached, date of transaction etc etc.  Why get rid of really helpful things when updating an app. Surely you must look at other versions before making a new one??

Please folks, just make the app simple and straight forward and make it work properly.

reviews.title: Terrible to use constant bugs
reviews.text:
Having been forced to switch to MTD I have had to find a software to use. App often loses ability to add an expense, unable to allocate receipts to expenses within the app, splitting abilities get lost depending on updates. Absolutely awful but now I’m stuck with it. With a paid for app I would expect QA to be better on updates and not miss crucial functionality like quickly adding in an expense without having to log onto the laptop.
I did all of the things you have suggested and even spoke to your support team. I cancelled and asked for a refund as the functionality has been removed completely. I was refused a refund and instructed to ask Apple directly for a refund. Shocking customer service on top of an extremely poor solution.

reviews.title: Shocking Upgrade
reviews.text:
I’m self employed and have been using Quickbooks app for over 6 years. I chose not to go with the closing of their old app to the new upgrade (which I was happy with but it was I was hardly using it and it increased in price in 2024). 
So have recently renewed it with the new FY and am shocked at how badly it runs. 
The mileage auto track is literally non existent at tracking and keep having to manually input or it loads but delayed. Many other things I dislike about this new app. Old one worked really well and dashboard, invoicing, p&l reports, tax return etc worked seamlessly. 
Will wait for the 6 month offer to finish and then go back to FreeAgent through Mettle. 
This app feels prehistoric to use.

reviews.title: Perpetual loading screen
reviews.text: The app never loads my buisness. Just sits idling forever until it fails then logs me out. Also, the constant need to input password or get a text just to access my business is draining. Make it compatible with Face ID like banking apps do. Like every single other app does. You’d think for a company this large they would have some programmers who’d at least get the basics right. Oh and the layout of this app is also draining everything is a nightmare to locate. Thankfully I have not managed to get past login page for a while so maybe it’s been updated. This app will bring your sorrow I wouldn’t even install it.

reviews.title: Terrible! Not intuitive. Terrible app navigation.
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this for a couple of days. It kept logging me out, so every time I opened it I had to log back in:time consuming. After much searching and no idea how I found it, I found a way to keep me logged in. But there’s one of my main points, app navigation is absolutely terrible! I’ve got no idea how to find anything, I just have to keep pressing things in the hope I find it. No clear explanation of how to link receipts to payments from non linked bank accounts/credit cards. 
It stopped linking with my bank accounts, I think I’ve figured  out how to relink it,  but no idea why it happened. It’s stopped tracking my trips, can’t get it working again and neither could 30 minutes in the phone to their helpline. 
It’s literally just updated and now if I go into the menu there’s no button to get back to the dashboard! I have to completely close and restart the app. Absolutely ridiculous!!

reviews.title: Not for me, slow, confusing, etc
reviews.text: this is a confusing and difficult to use app. Not sure why the ratings are so good, I feel like a lot of people in my position would not like it at all. I’m not a paperwork person, I’m not a computer work person. I just build stuff and needed a better way to keep up with stuff and this has made it more difficult to keep up with receipts and invoices. The app is very buggy and glitchy. I have it on two phones. one phone it crashes on every time I open it even after updating it. Invoicing… It took me 15 minutes to send somebody an invoice after spending hours getting it set up. All I wanted to do was text it and email it to them and I couldn’t even do that. There was no way for me to text it to them. There was no way for me to add images to my invoices other than the logo in the top of the page. The website is very confusing. At least the app is easier to navigate, but it’s still flooded with a bunch of stuff that I don’t need and don’t want. Also no dark mode??? Are you serious? So when I’m filling out an invoice or an estimate for somebody before bed, I get flash-banged by my computer screen and my phone screen… we’re in 2026 people… sheesh. Also on my work phone, which is a brand new iPhone 14, the app is extremely laggy and slow. It is a brand new phone with a brand new battery and it hardly has any other apps on it. Why do I have to have the latest highest end model of a phone to run a basic accounting software? On my 15 Pro Max it runs smoothly. Tried to disable mileage t

reviews.title: Bring back the old swipe system!
reviews.text:
Not as good as it used to be. I have to manually re categorise most transactions because it's predicting them for me and mostly getting them wrong. I can't have rules like I used to. And I miss the old swiping system, it's so easy to miss categorising a transaction properly because they don't disappear once sorted. I'd much prefer to manually sort transactions like I used to rather than relying on quickbooks predicting their categories incorrectly.

To respond to the developer response - maybe I didn't explain it properly? The AI banking is NOT learning my categories correctly so I have to manually change them anyway, and the banking rules aren't the same as before and are limited to how many rules I can have. 
I still prefer the old system.

reviews.title: Used to be better
reviews.text: I saw that a lot of reviews are from a few years ago and wanted to come on here to point out that when I started using this app 3 years ago I had no complaints. BUT… Now this app is riddled with constant annoyances. From little things like bank accounts “updating” their totals but the app doesn’t bother to upload the new transactions to categorize. Or that there is no way to send an invoice reminder without the AI “helper” rewriting what you wrote, unless you close it out and then there is no predictive text or spell check on the page. That is just to name a few. I have found it way easier for the first time in 3 years to just go on the desk top and do everything from invoicing to account categorizing because it’s not worth the frustrations of trying to use an app that worked great a year ago. This is inconvenient for me as a trucker who does most of his work on QuickBooks while sitting in a drivers seat getting loaded. I wish they would address all of the bugs they have been seaming to breed is this software.

reviews.title: Sometime it works
reviews.text:
Glitches that appear minor in the app become a big deal, especially when they are the few features that you actually need. Specific to my case the invoices stop loading at a certain number. The app needs to be restarted generally four times in order for the latest stream to properly appear. There is no default option to clear filters. And many times clicking through isn’t helpful. Also glitches in trying to message invoices that have not already been emailed. And some inconsistency in the buttons to share via message. Online checking leaves much to be desired. My feeling is the money you pay for the QuickBooks subscription just isn’t worth it.

Welcome to 2026 quickbooks, the app is worse than ever more updates, more problems, more glitches. Thank you QB for your response it was not helpful. Refreshing the app might work but at this point only once in a blue moon. More frustrated and angry now than I was in 2025! 

You need to figure out how to filters in your estimates and invoices, since once they’re set, they never seem to clear and are completely confused toggling through them only makes things worse than most times you will be shown zero results. Invoices from 2024 invoices from 2023 at the same for estimates it seems to be chaos.

The app is so scattered, it’s like someone drag and dropped some 90’s power point graphs everywhere. Actual logical clean listed layout is no where to be seen. Key features are missing from most pages. No lead review or tasks generated in leads. Which would actually be useful to review on your phone. It’s like it’s desperately trying to become something but the people responsible for the layout and function have never run a small business of their own and have no idea what key data you might need. I know let’s just cover the app in pie charts and graphs that’ll do 🤦🏻‍♂️

reviews.title: Scam and strong arming
reviews.text:
The software functions, as do 
many others. But I did not want customers paying electronically. So I turned off the CC and ACH payments. Then when they updated the app they automatically opted all users in for their customers paying electronically via ACH and a $25 “convenience” fee. Not realizing this change had been made, I sent an invoice to a customer. They paid a $150 invoice with a $25 fee. After hours on the phone with customer service, scouring the app, website, mobile and on the laptop, customer service and customer service from the office of the president informed me there is no way to refund my customer. They signed me up even though I had opted out and didn’t have a linked bank account. Now they recommend I link the account, rather than wait a month for it to be rejected after they earn a bit of interest on it (probably less than their $25 fee). Once I get my money I’m going to start testing out alternative software. What a total scam.

reviews.title: App isn't worth it
reviews.text: I've been a 20 year user and I can't recommend this app anymore. If you subscribe, expect significant price increases every year. This isn't for new features either since significant ones like payroll are add-ons that you have to pay even more for. On top of that the app doesn't even work most of the time. I've submitted feedback for years and things just don't get fixed. For example, invoices haven't loaded correctly for me for several years. New ones just don't show up on the list and aren't searchable. I have to go into the web site to find them. On top of that, the websites invoices don't match the ones in the app. Another example - it takes forever for the transactions to load in the app - they don't load 90% of the time and I have to force quit the app and restart and force quit and restart before they finally (sometimes) appear. This is another issue that I've submitted countless tickets on and it still hasn't been fixed. Scanned receipts don't match transactions most of the time. I have to enter them in a convoluted way just to get them to show up as something that can match...anyway I can go on and on. Don't subscribe if you want to simply have a usable accounting package that works. This isn't it and the price increases despite it not functioning is ridiculous.

reviews.title: Update has made this app awful!
reviews.text: Since the update, the entire. Layout is terrible. It’s incredibly buggy, very slow, crashes EVERY SINGLE TIME! Doesn’t work properly, customer service is non existent, it’s like they had too many customers and decided they don’t want them anymore as everyone I know who used QuickBooks is now switching to other invoicing providers. They also increased the price by the way. So that’s another reason to make a switch. (You can carry all the data from QuickBooks to other accounting software) even my accountant is having problems with QuickBooks and she’s a professional.

reviews.title: Stopped working after the update
reviews.text:
Update 21 Nov 25.
Support have no idea what the app developers are doing. Last nights update seems to have restored some of the broken functions (it has taken a week to get back the most fundamental of features).

My support ticket has had no update since I logged it. Awful service!


Update (Nov 25). Intuit are once again using its subscription paying customers to Beta test their app! Spoiler alert, it’s junk!

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME WITH QUICKBOOKS IF YOU NEED TO USE IT ON YOUR PHONE.

What to longer after the last big update is now impossible. Creating an invoice is no longer possible without a long winded work around, but then you can’t view or edit it from the customer record. This and duplicate menu items, freezing up, painfully slow to login, awful! 
I assume you will catch the industry saboteurs who did this and send them back and release the kidnapped developers from the stationary cupboard soon, I hope!!

This was working fine until the software update (May ‘25), now it’s full of errors and takes much longer to do a simple invoice. They have also removed the option for date and time per invoice entry which is very frustrating.

Intuit, please consider breaking changes and consult
with your PAYING customers before releasing major software changes.

reviews.title: If it’s not broke then don’t fix it!
reviews.text:
Before the last two updates this app was brilliant.
Straight forward, invoices easy to do, categories matched what I wanted.

Now, invoices take an age to do as they’ve changed the whole thing and you have to do it all separately. If you press return (to break a sentence to a separate paragraph) it jumps you to the very bottom of whatever you’ve written so you constantly have to scroll back up to carry on writing.
If you accidentally swipe down it exits the invoice and you lose all of what you’ve written.

Expense categories now keep being incorrectly adjusted when trying to do your categorisations, matching to incorrect invoices etc.

It keeps showing that I’m owed £500+ but all my invoices except one are paid, but then if I click it, it changes to £45? So that’s wrong.

It worked so well before the last two updates, now it’s broken and irritating to use. Why change something that required no changes?!

reviews.title: Constant issues, and getting worse all the time
reviews.text: Developers like push huge changes to the app on Friday when everybody is about to leave the office. Most the time there are huge issues with these updates and they don’t get addressed until late the next week. I haven’t been able to access invoices for over a week now because of one such update. This is the one of the main features of the app and it’s been down for over a week. When we first got QuickBooks five years ago it was great.
